about:
Manchester Molding & Mfg. Co., Inc. has operated in Manchester, Connecticut since 1967. The family-owned business began with a focus on in-house mold design, building, and thermoplastic injection molding, and has continued under the same ownership for over five decades.

The company specializes in custom injection molding, including temporary molds and short production runs. Its capabilities extend to in-house mold design and construction, supported by a tool room equipped with a CNC bed-type mill with three-axis conversational control and additional CNC machine tools. Production runs on vertical, horizontal, and shuttle-type injection molding presses ranging from 40 to 500 tons, with round-the-clock scheduling available. Secondary services include ultrasonic welding, pad printing, assembly, and special packaging.

Manchester Molding serves customers across all industries, though the company does not highlight specific sectors or named clients in its public materials.

The firm emphasizes quick response to production needs, on-time delivery, competitive pricing, and a commitment to high-quality products and services.
